theorem split_run {ιS : Type} {spec : OracleSpec ιS} {S G : Type}
    (handler : QueryImpl spec (StateT S (OracleComp A))) (free : QueryImpl spec (StateT G (OracleComp (A + T))))
    (table : QueryImpl (A + T) (StateT C (OracleComp A))) (join : C → G → S)
    (step : ∀ query cache state, (handler query).run (join cache state) =
      (fun result : (spec.Range query × G) × C => (result.1.1, join result.2 result.1.2)) <$>
        (simulateQ table ((free query).run state)).run cache)
    {α : Type} (work : OracleComp spec α) (cache : C) (state : G) :
    (simulateQ handler work).run (join cache state) =
      (fun result : (α × G) × C => (result.1.1, join result.2 result.1.2)) <$>
        (simulateQ table ((simulateQ free work).run state)).run cache

theorem push_stateless (layer : QueryImpl A (OracleComp B))
    (coinsA : ∀ {α : Type}, ProbComp α → OracleComp A α) (coinsB : ∀ {α : Type}, ProbComp α → OracleComp B α)
    (op : QueryImpl T (StateT C ProbComp))
    (faithful : ∀ {α : Type} (work : ProbComp α), simulateQ layer (coinsA work) = coinsB work)
    {α : Type} (work : OracleComp (A + T) α) (cache : C) :
    simulateQ layer ((simulateQ (tableAt coinsA op) work).run cache) =
      (simulateQ (tableAt coinsB op) (simulateQ (fwd layer) work)).run cache

theorem push_option {J : Type} (layer : QueryImpl A (OptionT (StateT J (OracleComp B))))
    (coinsA : ∀ {α : Type}, ProbComp α → OracleComp A α) (coinsB : ∀ {α : Type}, ProbComp α → OracleComp B α)
    (op : QueryImpl T (StateT C ProbComp))
    (faithful : ∀ {α : Type} (work : ProbComp α) (state : J),
      ((simulateQ layer (coinsA work)).run).run state = (fun reply => (some reply, state)) <$> coinsB work)
    {α : Type} (work : OracleComp (A + T) α) (state : J) (cache : C) :
    (fun result : (Option α × J) × C => (result.1.1.map (fun value => (value, result.2)), result.1.2)) <$>
        (simulateQ (tableAt coinsB op) (((simulateQ (fwdOption layer) work).run).run state)).run cache =
      ((simulateQ layer ((simulateQ (tableAt coinsA op) work).run cache)).run).run state

deviations_from_plan: S1b: layered services skeleton instead of a flattened handler; the services serverRoot, beaconRoot and table are the two skeleton oracles (hidden reads by coordinates, direct reads); the section 18 services are the record Hidden with exactly the required field types (hiddenBuild, hiddenAfter).

S1b: grouped Beacon finish (one request for the root and its continuation); the encapsulation-hiding wrapper of the resumed client is dropped by an equality (forward_actual); embed has placeholders in the Server identity fields and the KEM field, which no service reads.
S1b: the hidden Server value is first read at the resumption's private root request, not at the build (CE-11 design v2 section 5.7 expected the hidden build).

S1c: the prefix table-read log is realized as a key-count potential of the table cache along the scan (scan_potential); the residual counts all table reads after the cut plus the resumption; the bound is the plan's coefficient-one term.

S2: the IsRoot count goes through the skeleton's hidden reads; KemOpaqueCosts.client_root enters through S1c's resume_root; the continuation's finish budget is inherited (scan_inherit) without subtracting finishes before the cut, giving the plan's conservative qRoot = 1 + qFinish.
